children.name: Setchellanthus caeuruleus Brandegee
children.description: A xeromorphic, mustard-scented desert shrub with large, showy blue flowers bearing numerous stamens in 5-7 groups; the sole species of the genus Setchellanthus and the monotypic family Setchellanthaceae (order Brassicales). It is endemic to Mexico with a strongly disjunct distribution, from the northern Chihuahuan Desert to the Tehuacan-Cuicatlan valley, where it is rare.
